newsitem.title: UK: London shares end higher but fall short of record.
newsitem.headline: London shares end higher but fall short of record.

text.p: UK shares fell short of a record high on Tuesday but still managed solid gains as investors continued to hope that the market's appetite for equities had not yet been satisfied.

A sluggish start on Wall Street and market nerves ahead of Federal Reserve chief Alan Greenspan's testimony before the U.S. Congress tomorrow, prevented a record close, leaving the FTSE 100 index of leading stocks up 13.6 points to 4,344.7.
"Wall Street didn't do enough to push us over the top," the head of trading at a major investment bank said. "With Greenspan speaking tomorrow, I think the market will consolidate."
